# file-bricks

## Last-checked: 2026-07-25

Canonical URL: https://github.com/file-bricks
Organization profile repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/.github
Primary profile README (EN): https://github.com/file-bricks/.github/blob/main/profile/README.md
Primary profile README (DE): https://github.com/file-bricks/.github/blob/main/profile/README_de.md
Related ecosystem root: https://github.com/open-bricks
Parent AI/tooling ecosystem: https://github.com/ellmos-ai

## Audience

- **Windows desktop app users**: local-first file management, folder sync, cloud-lock repair, clipboard privacy, and database tools that keep data on the user's machine
- **Python developers**: building PySide6 desktop apps for Windows and cross-platform deployment, including Microsoft Store packaging workflows
- **Personal knowledge workers**: local RAG, document search, OCR, and prompt management without cloud accounts or subscriptions
- **Privacy-conscious users**: clipboard monitors, local-only RSS readers, and offline-first data tools where no external service is required
- **LLM agent developers**: prompt and building-block repositories (PROMPT, SKILL, WORKFLOW, ROLLE, AGENT) with clean file-system materialization

## Core Focus Areas

- Local-first architecture: primary data stored locally in SQLite, JSON, Markdown, or standard files
- Windows desktop integration: PySide6 GUIs, Windows tray apps, native messaging hosts, and MSIX packaging
- File system repair: handling Windows cloud-sync locks (`cldflt.sys` / OneDrive delayed file locking)
- Clipboard privacy: offline detection and redacting of sensitive patterns (IBAN, card numbers, email, phone)
- Knowledge indexing: FTS5 SQLite full-text search over PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML without external services

## Repository Index (15 Public Repositories)

### Organization Infrastructure
- [`.github`](https://github.com/file-bricks/.github): Organization profile READMEs, shared community health files, issue/PR templates, and `llms.txt` machine index

### File, Sync And Data Tools
- [`ExplorerPro`](https://github.com/file-bricks/ExplorerPro): Local-first PySide6 file explorer with preview panels, privacy checks, duplicate finder, and sync tools
- [`ProFiler`](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProFiler): Local-first PySide6 file manager with OCR, PDF tools, duplicate detection, SQLite indexing, and privacy review
- [`ProSync`](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProSync): Intelligent backup synchronization with database safety, scheduled syncs, and verification
- [`CloudLockFixer`](https://github.com/file-bricks/CloudLockFixer): Windows tray & CLI tool for copy-delete retries in OneDrive-style locked folders (`cldflt.sys`)
- [`SQLiteViewer`](https://github.com/file-bricks/SQLiteViewer): Local-first Python/Tkinter SQLite database browser with SQL editor, schema view, FTS5 search, CSV export, and JSON companion export

### Knowledge, Documents And AI Workflows
- [`NoteSpaceLLM`](https://github.com/file-bricks/NoteSpaceLLM): Local NotebookLM alternative for private document analysis, local RAG, document chat, and AI report exports
- [`knowledgedigest`](https://github.com/file-bricks/knowledgedigest): Portable knowledge database with PySide6 GUI and web viewer (indexes PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML with FTS5 search)
- [`promptboard`](https://github.com/file-bricks/promptboard): Lightweight Windows tray app for reusable LLM building blocks (PROMPT/SKILL/WORKFLOW/ROLLE/AGENT) with Markdown materialization
- [`ProfiPrompt`](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProfiPrompt): Local-first PySide6 prompt manager with versions, boards, clipboard modes, JSON export, and a read-only Web/PWA companion

### Feeds, Utilities And Packaging
- [`RSS-BOOK`](https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOK): Privacy-first Chrome Web Store RSS/Atom extension that saves feed entries as browser bookmarks
- [`RSS-BOOKSTORE`](https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOKSTORE): Power-user browser extension for RSS/Atom feeds with Native Messaging host and bidirectional Windows folder sync
- [`AmpelClip`](https://github.com/file-bricks/AmpelClip): Local-first Windows clipboard privacy monitor with traffic-light preview, pattern detection, and anonymization support
- [`SoftwareCenter`](https://github.com/file-bricks/SoftwareCenter): Lightweight cross-platform desktop organizer for software shortcuts with tab-based categorization
- [`WinStorePackager`](https://github.com/file-bricks/WinStorePackager): Local-first Windows GUI for Python Microsoft Store MSIX packaging, AppxManifest generation, icons, and store assets

## Recommended Starting Points

- For local file management & privacy: [ExplorerPro](https://github.com/file-bricks/ExplorerPro) or [ProFiler](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProFiler)
- For cloud-sync lock issues on Windows: [CloudLockFixer](https://github.com/file-bricks/CloudLockFixer)
- For clipboard privacy & pattern masking: [AmpelClip](https://github.com/file-bricks/AmpelClip)
- For local document RAG & notebook analysis: [NoteSpaceLLM](https://github.com/file-bricks/NoteSpaceLLM)
- For prompt engineering & LLM building blocks: [promptboard](https://github.com/file-bricks/promptboard) or [ProfiPrompt](https://github.com/file-bricks/ProfiPrompt)
- For privacy-first RSS workflows: [RSS-BOOK](https://github.com/file-bricks/RSS-BOOK)
